rationale.rules-based-checks: Builds static analyzers and unit-test checks for generated programs.
rationale.ai-code-insecurity: Measures generated-code CWEs and SQL-injection failures across benchmarks.
rationale.quality-debt: Measures maintainability defects including typing, dead code, and signatures.
rationale.framework: REAL integrates grounded quality checks into a reusable training architecture.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented, evaluated, and publicly released REAL.
rationale.agentic: Models generate complete programs as the reviewable unit.
rationale.steering: Program-analysis rewards shape model generation through reinforcement learning.
rationale.metrics: Defines joint functionality-security and functionality-quality pass-rate metrics.
rationale.risk-security: Evaluates security mitigation across 18 CWEs and SQL injection.
rationale.risk-quality: Evaluates maintainability mitigation using typing and structural checks.
